items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: I think it was George Treey on drums, played fine drums. one of my dad's students who played fine.

ctx.x: And Henry, how do you pronounce his name? Harry Tarzan, T-A-U-C-I-N. Harry Tarzan. Harry Tarzan. Yeah, he played good clarinet, played real good clarinet. And you knew him, huh?

Oh yes, oh, well played a little bit. I know almost nothing about him. Well, Harry Tarzan played, before I went out to the, uh, uh, the, uh, the, uh, the, uh, before I played before I had a band out at the, uh, Roadhouse out there, I heard him playing with a band and I think he was playing with- Jules Cherzaud was playing piano. I think Mary Brunesse was playing cornet in them days, Harry Tarzan clarinet. And I think it was George Treey on drums, played fine drums. one of my dad's students who played fine. He…
